label: List Price
source_rule: Price Rule, Option Unit Price or Price Book when its recorded value equals List Price; else not determined from the recorded data

label: Special Price
source_rule: Bundled when a bundled option has zero Special Price; else Special price type or special source rule; null when Special equals List

label: Regular Price
source_rule: Discount Schedule when a schedule applied; Bundled when a bundled option first reaches zero at Regular

label: Customer Price
source_rule: Additional Discount when manual discount applies

label: Partner Price
source_rule: Partner Discount when partner discount applies

label: Net Price
source_rule: Distributor Discount when distributor discount applies
